scope: fr_FR malformed-code repairs and missing x-default on isolated Hugo/Nuxt fixtures, including a known FR/EN/DE fallback policy

corrector_changes.policy: Reuse consistent explicit x-default destinations from healthy, directly linked, reciprocal translations in the same observed group, never a site-wide vote. The destination must also be observed and usable before an exact policy is inferred.
corrector_changes.conflicts: Conflicting peer defaults or an observed non-indexable destination refuse preparation before GitHub content reads. Scoped/newline/semicolon noindex directives are recognized.
corrector_changes.before_write: Pass exact source-to-default choices to Claude and verify exactly one matching literal annotation on mapped per-page source files before GitHub PUT. Wrong, duplicate or unsupported literals are skipped without a write.
corrector_changes.nuxt: Share the existing bounded single-useHead literal-link-array parser with reciprocal repairs. Dynamic/computed/spread structures and unsupported JavaScript escapes abstain when the exact-destination guard applies.
corrector_changes.no_observed_policy: No new default preference is invented by the resolver. Existing AI behavior outside the inferred per-page scope remains, and is not universally certified. Shared builders without a per-page mapping are outside this exact literal guard.
corrector_changes.invalid_code: No production rewriter change was required for the tested fr_FR to fr-FR correction. This is not validation of all language/region codes.

measurement.projection: Only a separate report copy maps structured preview URLs to the production namespace and removes the exact injected noindex header on source/final preview-host pages. Native meta robots, other directives, paths, case and query remain. The original scorer uses the sitemap XML actually served.
measurement.positive_controls: An existing fr_FR annotation and missing defaults must be observed before repair. Only the known group's EN x-default line is removed on a new QA baseline; FR/DE retain their existing French fallback, navigation and sitemap discovery.
measurement.direct_html_checks: After real exact-head builds and recrawls, all affected routes return HTTP 200. fr_FR becomes fr-FR with destinations unchanged; exactly one x-default points to an observed HTTP 200 self-canonical target without noindex in the controlled report. QA EN must use QA FR. Other annotations, title, description/tag count, canonical, lang, robots, headings and social metadata remain unchanged.
measurement.legacy_fixture_choices: For old fixtures without an explicit peer policy, root or an existing FR edition are allowed controls. These fixture choices do not certify customer preferences.
measurement.remaining_occurrence: The preexisting language-code collision requires arbitration and is deliberately unchanged.

initial_bad_attempt.reason: Counters reached zero but the EN translation chose itself as x-default instead of the explicit FR fallback used by its FR/DE peers. The independent semantic HTML check rejected this result.

verification.independent_countercheck: GitHub main identities, all six draft/closed/unmerged PRs, exact built heads and baseline-to-correction file changes were re-read. HTML policy checks were recomputed; current per-page literal guards accepted the real final source. All four projected page lists match the captured reports. Report/sitemap SHA256 fingerprints are retained.
verification.postgresql: No new PostgreSQL run in this content-only phase; previous real recovery/concurrency evidence remains separate.

limitations: Raw previews remain noindex; projected scores do not prove production deployment or search-engine indexing.
Hugo raw_head and bounded literal Nuxt useHead are exercised. Arbitrary customer/shared/dynamic templates and other frameworks are not universally certified.
An absent or unobserved group policy is not proof of the right default preference. Existing AI behavior outside the inferred per-page scope is not universally certified.
Only fr_FR to fr-FR was tested live; this is not complete ISO language/region validation.
The legacy reciprocal language-code collision remains unresolved without ownership arbitration.

This phase does not certify remaining title/duplicate/content families, customer billing, scheduling, live billable batches or partial-content-write crash recovery. No agent deployment or client write occurred.
remaining_release_checks: Complete explicitly selected remaining AI-written families, including duplicate descriptions and titles.
Exercise real billable batch and partial-content-write recovery with GitHub and isolated PostgreSQL together.
Validate deployment startup/schedulers, capacity, receipt retention and onboarding/billing lifecycle, then supervise pilots.
